caption: The drawing depicts a white, empire-waisted dress with short, puffed sleeves that have gathered bands at the cuffs. The neckline is wide and rounded, adorned with a delicate, scalloped edge trim. The bodice is constructed with visible seam lines for shaping, and the waistline is slightly raised, sitting just below the bust. The skirt flows straight down from the empire waist to the hem, and at the bottom, there is an ornate pattern in dark color forming a decorative border around the edge of the dress. The fabric is rendered in shades of white and cream with light shadowing to suggest draping and transparency. The overall composition presents the dress centered vertically and front-facing on a plain, light background. At the bottom right corner, there is text reading "L.M. BURGE 3.7."
title: Day Dress
